bundle.shortDescription: Biomedical-instrumentation teaching software for BMEG 420L. Teaching use only; not a medical device.
bundle.longDescription:
WVU Bioinstrumentation Studio acquires, plots, calibrates, and saves biomedical-instrumentation signals from an Arduino UNO R4 WiFi for the BMEG 420L teaching laboratory.

Teaching use only. It is not a medical device and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions.
